donors.reason: Biflavonoid polyphenol with antineoplastic and enzyme-inhibitory activities; closest flavonoid scaffold among retrieved donors.
Dihydroxyflavone CDK9 inhibitor; flavonoid scaffold plausibly perturbs chromatin-linked transcription, though anchor similarity is negative.

revised_hypotheses: Gossypetin, a hexahydroxyflavone, may alter histone methylation/acetylation in A375 via flavonoid-mediated chromatin-modifying enzyme effects, with H3K27me1K36me2 loss and H3K56me0 gain as leading anchor signals.
Among retrieved donors, only Ginkgetin and Alvocidib share a flavonoid scaffold; both are plausible but weakly supported transfer donors for gossypetin-like chromatin responses.
unresolved: No retrieved donor has measured A375 histone-mark responses or high anchor similarity to gossypetin.
Exifone, curcumin, and Resveratrol lack retrieved pharmacology descriptions, so their donor support cannot be cited.
Whether gossypetin produces a reproducible >0.5 log2 histone perturbation versus vehicle remains untested.
